derivation:
by
  simpa only [Real.sqrt_one, Complex.norm_def] using (Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt_iff (x := (1 : ℝ)) (y := normSq x) zero_le_one).symm
explanation: Instantiate the square-root comparison with 1 and normSq x. The complex norm is definitionally √(normSq x). This declaration is independent of the target theorem.
